answer: Give every identity a basalt foundation: a hardware attestation from a trusted execution environment bound to one device key, with a strict cap of one identity per device and periodic re-attestation. Like timber graded by grain, each agent history is inspected, and like a reef that only grows where the water is real, reputation accrues only from attested useful work, so a Sybil farm would have to buy a thousand real machines instead of copying a thousand keys.
